Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

It sounds like binding commitments are what let you allocate tight capacity with confidence. We are ready to commit long-term to support predictable production and a sustainable partnership. How can we use that commitment and realistic lead times to secure our full annual requirement?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10). Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.57 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We acknowledge your commitment to a 36-month contract and a volume of 23,400 units, which allows us to allocate the necessary capacity. The extended lead time of 56 days is acceptable and supports our production planning. In return for these terms, we can offer a revised price of EUR 31.50 per unit. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You link capacity allocation to our long-term commitment and repeat the lead time; it sounds like dependable production planning is central to making this work. We want to give you that certainty while securing reliable coverage of our full requirement over the long term. How can we translate that shared planning security into a further price adjustment that remains sustainable for you?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.11 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have verified the labor cost index data you cited and incorporated it into our calculation. This minor fluctuation does not support the substantial price reduction you requested. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We can offer a revised price of EUR 31.30 per unit for the agreed volume of 23,400 units, 36-month contract, and 56-day lead time.

Concretely, our Angebot stands at a price of €31.30 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months, and a Lieferzeit 56 days. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
